items.source: Verify that all expected requests set up via expect(RequestMatcher) were indeed performed.
items.translation: 验证通过 `expect(RequestMatcher)` 设置的所有预期请求确实已执行。

items.source: matcher - request matcher
items.translation: matcher - 请求匹配器

items.source: a representation of the expectation
items.translation: 期望的表示

items.translation: 模拟服务器

items.source: This method may be invoked any number times before starting to make request through the underlying RestTemplate in order to set up all expected requests.
items.translation: 此方法可在通过底层 `<code>RestTemplate` 发起请求之前被调用任意次数，以设置所有预期的请求。

items.source:
When request expectations have an expected count greater than one, only
the first execution is expected to match the order of declaration. Subsequent
request executions may be inserted anywhere thereafter.
items.translation: 当请求期望的期望计数大于一时，仅预期第一次执行按声明顺序匹配。随后的请求执行可插入到之后的任何位置。

items.source: Return a builder for a MockRestServiceServer that should be used to reply to the RestClient for the given RestClient.Builder.
items.translation: 返回一个用于回复给定 `RestClient.Builder` 的 `RestClient` 的 `MockRestServiceServer` 构建器。

items.source: Return a builder for a MockRestServiceServer that should be used to reply to the RestTemplate for the given RestGatewaySupport.
items.translation: 返回一个用于回复给定RestGatewaySupport的RestTemplate的MockRestServiceServer构建器。

items.source: Return a builder for a MockRestServiceServer that should be used to reply to the given RestTemplate.
items.translation: 返回一个用于回复给定 `<code>RestTemplate` 的 `<code>MockRestServiceServer` 构建器。

items.source: An alternative to expect(RequestMatcher) that also indicates how many times the request is expected to be executed.
items.translation: 作为 `expect(RequestMatcher)` 的替代方案，它还能指明请求预期执行的次数。

items.source: Variant of verify() that waits for up to the specified time for all expectations to be fulfilled.
items.translation: `verify()` 的变体，等待指定的最长时间以完成所有期望。

items.source: Variant of verify() that waits for up to the specified time for all expectations to be fulfilled. This can be useful for tests that involve asynchronous requests.
items.translation: `verify()` 的变体，它会等待指定的时间，直到所有期望得到满足。这对于涉及异步请求的测试非常有用。

items.source: A shortcut for bindTo(restTemplate).build().
items.translation: bindTo(restTemplate).build() 的快捷方式。

items.source: A shortcut for bindTo(restGateway).build().
items.translation: bindTo(restGateway).build() 的快捷方式。

items.source: Reset the internal state removing all expectations and recorded requests.
items.translation: 重置内部状态，移除所有期望和已记录的请求。

items.source: AssertionError - if not all expectations are met
items.translation: AssertionError - 如果未满足所有预期

items.source: AssertionError - if not all expectations are met by the specified timeout, or if any expectation fails at any time before that.
items.translation: AssertionError - 如果未能在指定的超时时间内满足所有期望，或者在此之前的任何时间期望失败。

items.source: count - the expected count
items.translation: count - 预期的计数

items.translation: restTemplate - 用于设置模拟测试的 RestTemplate

items.source: restGateway - the REST gateway to set up for mock testing
items.translation: restGateway - 用于设置模拟测试的 REST 网关
